Press Release:


Murder By Appointment
They’ve been dubbed the Krugersdorp Killers: the bizarre story of the Steyn family - a mother, her two teenage children and friends who are on trial for the brutal murders of 11 people. The group unleashed a reign of terror that lasted 4 years, allegedly committing additional crimes ranging from robbery, aggravated assault and fraud to identity theft. But how did their killing spree finally come to an end? Carte Blanche investigates.


Script:


MURDER BY APPOINTMENT

V/O:​The West Rand mining town of Krugersdorp has been at the centre of a vicious crime campaign since 2012.

Devi link:​In a country where thousands of people are murdered every year, this case stands out. A gang of alleged killers made up of friends and family, including a mother and her two children, are charged with committing eleven murders between them.

V/O:​Five gang members are on trial in the Johannesburg High Court, all charged with murder, robbery, theft, fraud, forgery, racketeering and possession of unlicensed firearms and ammunition.

Accused 1 is Zak Valentine, a North West
University graduate and former financial advisor for Discovery Life.

Accused 2 is Cecilia Steyn, a mother of two who is married to a policeman.

Leroux Steyn, began working as Zak Valentine’s assistant after leaving school. He is not related to Cecilia.

His mother is Marinda Steyn, who was teaching English at a local high school at the time of her arrest.

Her other child is Marcel Steyn, who matriculated
in 2015 with 4 distinctions. She was 18 when she was arrested.

The 6th member of the group John Barnard, has already been convicted. He’s turned state witness for a 10-year reduction in his 30-year sentence.

Giada:​You will often have a strong personality that will dominate a group like that, that is quite manipulative, charming, very persuasive and quite adept at reading other people and manipulating their particular needs or vulnerabilities to have power over them.

V/O:​Forensic psychologist, Dr Giada del Fabbro, has studied the indictment. It states Cecilia Steyn is the leader of the group and manipulated others into executing her orders.

Giada:​It’s more useful to use an organized crime model, the model of a gang to understand this group, than that of a serial killer.

V/O:​Cecilia Steyn is a self-proclaimed Satanist. Here she is with Marinda, as well as Zak and his late wife Mikaela Valentine. In 2012 they joined a Christian group called Overcomers Through Christ, under the guise of needing deliverance from satanic bondage. When Cecilia clashed with Christian leader Ria Grunewald, they formed their own breakaway group called “Electus per Deus”, meaning Chosen by God, and all got matching tattoos.

Giada:​I think there’s huge power in rituals like that. So, it’s another way of cementing their unity and cementing their common goal and their membership.

V/O:​And their goal was revenge on Ria Grunewald. The murders started in July 2012. Overcomers Through Christ member Natacha Burger and her elderly neighbor Joyce Boonzaaier, had their throats slit in her Centurion townhouse. According to the indictment the killers were Zak Valentine and his wife Mikaela.

Gerard:​I don’t get the impression that any of these crimes were committed as part of a satanic ritual. It was to get rid of people.

V/O:​Forensic psychologist Dr Gerard Labuschagne headed up the Police’s Investigative Psychology Unit for 15 years.

Gerard:​It is such an anomaly to get a group of people who are sort of ideologically or belief-motivated to go out and do these things. How do you protect for that? How do you prevent that? You’re almost helpless, specifically if you knew these individuals before, and they decide in their own little world to turn against you, or that you’ve turned against them in some way and that justifies you being murdered.


Devi link:​According to the indictment, retired pastor Reginald Bendixon was next on Cecilia’s hit list. He had presented a few guest lectures to Overcomers Through Christ and Ria Grunewald regarded him as her mentor. Even though they had never met him, he was targeted by the group to take revenge on Ria.

V/O:​Zak Valentine and Marinda Steyn allegedly disguised themselves as police officers to gain entry to Bendixen’s home. Once inside the property they attacked the 75-year-old with knives and an axe. He collapsed and died on the pathway.

Devi:​In targeting Ria Grunewald, they didn’t go after Ria Grunewald the person, they went after people who were friends or in her close circle. What does that say?

Giada:​Well it speaks to a sadistic mindset, which is really about making the other person suffer. It was clear that they wanted Ria Grunewald to suffer, to be hurt, so it wasn’t enough to just get rid of her.

V/O:​Cecilia Steyn was not present at any of the murders herself, but they were allegedly committed at her insistence.

Giada:​In not taking part in any of the murders but making the other members of the group commit the murders, there’s also a sense of ensuring their allegiance, because she could very easily threaten them with that if they wanted to leave the group.

V/O:​And that is precisely what happened when Mikeila Valentine became disillusioned with her husband’s criminal activity. Worried that she might betray the group, they decided to kill her. Zak allegedly put a sedative in her coffee before going to work. He also gave Marinda Steyn a remote control for the complex gate and a key to the house.

Devi:​This is possibly the most shocking detail of this case. Marinda brought her 14-year-old daughter Marcel to Zak’s house to kill Mikaela. Together they allegedly stabbed and beat her to death with a blunt instrument.

Devi:​In which world is it ok for you to involve your child in a murder?

Giada:​It gives you a sense of how much she felt her world view or her perspective on things was legitimate – that she could bring her own child into that situation. She’s almost been portrayed as being under the influence of Cecilia Steyn, you either have a case of an incredibly dependent person who is so easily influenced and suggestive, or you’ve got someone who is pretty much cut from the same cloth who is working very effectively with this other person, they’ve sort of found each other.

V/O:​At the time Zak was employed by Discovery Life, and received a spousal death benefit of R400 000, according to Head of Legal Services Glenn Hickling.

Glenn:​It was presented as a break-in. The evidence that we had at the time was that he was already at work when it happened, and at the time for all of us it was a traumatic event.

V/O:​After a three-year lull, the group started another killing spree in 2015. Their friend John Barnard worked as a machine minder for wealthy businessman Peter Meyer. Believing he kept a large amount of cash at home, they set up a meeting at his mansion in Noordheuwel posing as business consultants. Marinda was armed when she arrived with Zak, and Marcel. They tied up Peter and his wife Joan before stabbing them to death.

Gerard:​​These were not spontaneous spur of the moment murders. Each one of them had forethought and planning. These people were targeted in terms of who they were going to kill next, so all of that does point from the legal point of view towards pre-planning, which would indicate hopefully when it comes to the sentencing that they get life sentences for each of those premeditated murders.

V/O:​​​The group’s next scheme was to defraud Discovery Life, by faking Zak’s death. He befriended a street vendor named Jarrod Jackson, and on the 16th of December drove him to the Free State in his Mercedes Benz SLK. They were followed by John Barnard and Leroux Steyn, who strangled Jarrod with a rope. On the R57 between Reitz and Petrus Steyn they set the car alight with the deceased still inside.

Glenn:​As the claims documents start coming in, our claims assessors take a little drive down to Petrus Steyn and get told by the investigating police officer, just hold on chaps, the blood type is different to what we thought the blood type of our life insured was.

V/O:​The police then did DNA testing on the body.


Glenn​The beneficiary is one Cecilia Steyn and when we run Cecilia’s ID number, we find out that she’s associated with some events in the past.

Devi:​​So how did you find out that she’s associated?

Glenn:​Through our sources in the police.

V/O:​The day after the fake accident, Zak’s body was identified by a fake family member.

Glenn:​This person identified herself as the sister of the deceased, this is Marinda Steyn. So, we know that she’s not the sister of the deceased.

Devi:​So the claim is put in, in the name of Zak Valentine?

Glenn:​Yes, for a substantial amount of money.

Devi:​​What was the value?

Glenn:​Some R3.7 million rand.

V/O:​On the day he faked his death, Zak went into hiding at Die Herberg Hotel in Krugersdorp, using a false name and stolen ID book. The hotel is a short distance from Cosanna Flats where all the Steyns were living: Cecilia and family in Flat number 1, and Marinda, Leroux and Marcel in Flat no 17.

Giada:​​Someone who isn’t a psychopath, will find it very difficult to understand why people do it, you know fake their own death and not think about the impact on their loved ones.

V/O:​In 2016 the appointment murders began. Tax consultant Glenn McGregor was allegedly shot by Marinda Steyn on his plot outside Krugersdorp after she approached him for tax advice.


V/O:​Financial planner Tony Scholefield was lured to Cosanna Flats for a meeting. Leroux Steyn has confessed to strangling him, before bundling his body into the boot of his car, which was abandoned on a street in Krugersdorp.

V/O:​Financial broker Kevin McAlpine was also lured to a business meeting at 17 Cosanna Flats. He met the same fate, and his car was also abandoned and his body later found in the boot.

V/O:​Later that week estate agent Hanle Lategan parked her car outside the Krugersdorp Private Hospital, for an appointment with a client. Hospital cameras filmed her being met by a woman before walking across the road to Cosanna Flats. She too was strangled in Flat No 17 and her body dumped in Randfontein.

Devi:​​Three of the murders took place in Marinda Steyn’s flat. I can’t get over that. How did she sleep at night?

Giada:​​To commit those murders in those ways you have to be able to objectify the person in some way so, you don’t feel anything about killing, no remorse or no guilt.

V/O:​According to John Barnard he, Marinda, Leroux and Marcel were present at all these murders. The victims bank cards were stolen and used to withdraw money at the Absa ATM in the local Spar. Reading about this in the press, Discovery Life assessors joined the dots.

Glenn:​The suspects had withdrawn some money from a cash machine with a card belonging to one of the victims, at a place near where Cecilia and Marinda Steyn live. We co-operated from that moment on with the South African Police.

V/O:​Through a combination of cell-phone triangulation, tip-offs from informants, DNA evidence and ATM camera footage the police were able to link all the suspects to the crimes. They are being held in custody at Johannesburg Prison, and the trial begins next week.
